description: The repository has no check that rejects attribution trailers in commit messages (Co-Authored-By, Co-Developed-By, Generated-By, Assisted-By, or a 'Generated with Claude Code' line). The project rule is that no commit carries such a trailer, but nothing enforces it for commits made by people or tools without a flow, and nothing proves the commits the flow engine itself writes stay clean.
goal: Add scripts/check_commit_trailers.py with a pure function find_attribution_lines(message) returning the offending lines (case-insensitive match on lines starting, after optional whitespace, with co-authored-by, co-developed-by, generated-by, assisted-by or 'generated with [claude code'; lines starting with '#' are comment lines and ignored), a --message-file mode that checks one commit message file, and a --range mode that checks every commit in a git revision range; both print each offence with the commit or file and exit non-zero when any exists. Add a git commit-msg hook .githooks/commit-msg that runs the script on the message file. Add a new workflow .github/workflows/test-commit-trailers.yml that runs on pull_request with a full-history checkout and runs the script with --range over the pull request's commits (base sha to head sha). Add a test that the flow engine's own commit messages pass the check. Do not edit any existing workflow or the workflows README. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: An invariant nothing checks slips through. A hook plus a CI check over the pull request's commits catch it whether or not the author ran hooks, and the engine test keeps the flow's own commits clean.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_commit_trailers.py runs scripts/check_commit_trailers.py --message-file on a real violating message ('feat: x' followed by a blank line and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>') and asserts a non-zero exit and the offending line on stderr; the same message in lower case and with a 'Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)' line also fails; a clean message with 'Action-Origin: pr_review' and 'Review-Iteration: 2' trailers exits 0.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_commit_trailers.py builds a temporary git repository with one clean commit and one commit carrying a Co-Authored-By trailer, and asserts --range over both fails naming only the offending commit's short sha, while --range over the clean commit alone exits 0.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_flow_commit_messages_have_no_attribution.py builds the review ledger commit message with _ledger_commit_message from sandbox_executor.flow.review.ledger_commit for iterations 0, 1 and 3 and with a reason, and the trailer block from format_commit_trailers in sandbox_executor.ledger.rows, and asserts find_attribution_lines returns nothing for each.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_commit_trailers.py asserts .githooks/commit-msg is executable, invokes scripts/check_commit_trailers.py with --message-file, and that .github/workflows/test-commit-trailers.yml runs on pull_request and calls the script with --range.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
